messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER: latency-surge service=inference-prod region=us-west severity=sev2 — median p95 token-latency spiked to 3.2s, error responses 1.8% :rotating_light:
Aisha Gomez: seeing it. i'm oncall, starting handoff. any customer hits noted?
Samir Rao: a few 5xxs in the ingress LB logs, correlates to kv-cache evict churn & high GC on embedder workers.
Marta Li: timeline? did we push anything?
Aisha Gomez: no deploys in last hour. rolling avg CPU on embedder nodes jumped at 12:07 UTC.
Ryan (devops): autoscaler didn't react — min-replicas pinned for these nodes, they hit a soft cap. manual scale up in progress: `kubectl scale deploy/embedder --replicas=8`
Priya Patel: adding customer-impact note: some search endpoints degraded for two enterprise customers (acct: acme, bluebay). engineering EMs pinged.
Samir Rao: mitigation plan: 1) manual scale embedder pool 2) enable routing fallback to smaller quantized model for latency-sensitive routes 3) disable prefix caching for long tails to reduce memory pressure.
Aisha Gomez: executed scale up at 12:12. latency p95 dropped to ~1.1s but still noisy. enabling fallback now.
Marta Li: PR to routing rules review: `routes.json` snippet:
```
{
  "routes": [
    {"path":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"rwk-small-q4","criteria":"latency>800ms"}
  ]
}
```
Samir Rao: applied fallback, traffic gradually moved at 12:20. customer impact reduced.
IncidentBot: NOTE: oncall handoff scheduled in 45m. create post-incident review if incident >30m.
Aisha Gomez: will own initial triage postmortem. tagging Priya + Samir for customer impact and root cause.
Priya Patel: collecting customer logs and support tickets, will assemble timeline and notify acct teams.
Ryan (devops): observed kvcache thrash: TTL eviction rate spiked when batch size jumped. hypothesis: bursty long-context requests bypassed prefix cache.
Samir Rao: root-cause hypothesis: atypical workload (very high variance in prefix lengths) exposed cache eviction policy + pinned autoscaler limits.
Marta Li: agree. also see OOM spikes on a subset of embedder pods; crashloop on 2/6 before scale.
Aisha Gomez: summary for post-incident: duration ~35m (12:07–12:42), severity sev2, customers impacted: Acme, BlueBay, approximate request-error uplift: +1.6%, latency p95 peak 3.2s.
Priya Patel: next steps — create action items and size them. propose we add to remediation backlog and Q2 roadmap tie-in for autoscaler policy work.
Samir Rao: Action items (draft):
- AI-421: Autoscaler policy: remove hard min-pin for embedder pool; implement reactive burst buffer (owner: Ryan) — est: medium (3-5d) — priority: P1 (Q2 roadmap)
- AI-422: KVCaching: change eviction policy to favor long-lived prefixes and add metrics for eviction churn (owner: Marta) — est: medium (3-5d) — priority: P1
- AI-423: Fallback routing: add automated canary and opt-in thresholds for quantized fallback (owner: Samir) — est: small (1-2d) — priority: P2
- AI-424: Investigate embedder memory tuning & add OOM alert (owner: Aisha) — est: small (1-2d) — priority: P1
- AI-425: Customer comms and RCA for Acme/BlueBay (owner: Priya) — est: small (1d) — priority: P0 for customer comms, P2 for engineering RCA
Aisha Gomez: add acceptance criteria for AI-421: autoscaler should add capacity within 90s of sustained CPU >70% for 3 consecutive 30s windows without human intervention.
Ryan (devops): for AI-421, propose spike-queue buffer with prewarmed instances; needs infra review — I'll open infra RFC.
Marta Li: AI-422 acceptance: eviction churn metric <0.5% of ops and p95 latency stable for 1 week under synthetic burst tests.
Samir Rao: prioritization notes: severity-based triage -> AI-425 (cust comms) asap, AI-424 + AI-423 next to prevent recurrence; AI-421 & AI-422 are larger infra items to land in Q2 sprint cycle.
Priya Patel: scheduling: propose postmortem meeting tomorrow 16:00 UTC, 60m. will create calendar invite and add owners.
Aisha Gomez: i can do the writeup skeleton. assign action items in tracker and tag in postmortem doc.
IncidentBot: REMINDER: Postmortem required. Template: link to /docs/postmortem-template — please include timeline, root cause hypothesis, mitigation, action items with owners.
Samir Rao: i'll add logs & flamegraphs to the postmortem. Marta can attach kvcache metrics.
Priya Patel: final ask: owners, confirm sizing & if any blockers to schedule into next sprint?
Ryan (devops): I confirm AI-421 est 3-5d, blocked by infra allocation approval (should be minor).
Marta Li: AI-422 est 3d, blocked if we need large schema changes to metrics pipeline.
Aisha Gomez: AI-424 I can pick up, est 1d, no blockers.
Samir Rao: AI-423 est 1d, I can ship with a simple threshold rule then iterate.
Priya Patel: I'll file the postmortem and link AI tickets to it. Invite: @Samir @Marta @Ryan @Aisha.
Marta Li: thanks — tagging Q2 roadmap owners for visibility :eyes: (cc @product-ops)
Aisha Gomez: handing off to morning oncall at 07:00 UTC in case followups surface.
Samir Rao: thanks all, closing pager. followup notes to live in the postmortem doc and ticket tracker. :thumbsup:
Priya Patel: noted, will update stakeholders with interim comms.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT STATUS: resolved -> mitigation applied, monitoring normal; postmortem scheduled.
